title: Puppet Master Doctor registry, router, and projection contracts
description: Closed descriptors, action requests, and normalized finding projections. Doctor checks are bounded read-only owner queries.

doctor_backup_connector_consumer_project.title: DoctorBackupConnectorConsumerProjection
doctor_backup_connector_consumer_project.description: Static N2-156 consumer contract for bounded Backup and PM connector owner projections. It is not a probe result, owner receipt, runtime evidence, or authority to mutate owner state.

doctor_scenario_projection.title: DoctorScenarioProjection
doctor_scenario_projection.description: A bounded static/browser-concept scenario projection for cross-row Doctor invariants that cannot be represented by one finding. It is not owner truth, native execution evidence, or a production runtime receipt.

doctor_cache_migration_receipt.title: DoctorCacheMigrationReceipt
doctor_cache_migration_receipt.description: Domain reconciliation receipt for the one-time Doctor descriptor/finding-cache migration. It preserves currentness metadata, names every dropped or quarantined row, performs no repair, and references the sole terminal durable pm.storage_value.migration_receipt.v1 receipt. The x-puppet-master-assertions rules are mandatory; a consumer that cannot enforce them must reject the receipt.
x-puppet-master-assertions: each source row has exactly one disposition
descriptor revision and finding owner/cache generation currentness are preserved without upgrading freshness

x-semantic-invariants: request return_context is byte-identical to result return_context

cmd.doctor.export_report.intended_semantics: Build one bounded, redacted Doctor report projection and export that exact artifact through the Doctor report contract; never reinterpret it as a Project FileManager copy-out request.

ui.doctor.copy_diagnostics.intended_semantics: Copy only the currently hydrated, bounded, redacted Doctor diagnostics projection.

ui.doctor.open.intended_semantics: Open the exact Doctor local surface or projection and restore its typed return/focus context without invoking unrelated owner work.

ui.doctor.open_details.intended_semantics: Open the exact current Doctor finding and preserve focus/currentness return context.

ui.doctor.open_remediation.intended_semantics: Navigate from Doctor to the exact semantic owner remediation and return only after a fresh owner result.

ui.doctor.refresh_visible.intended_semantics: Refresh the bounded currently visible Doctor projection under cache, deadline, and resource-governor rules.

ui.doctor.run_check.intended_semantics: Run one exact bounded Doctor check through its domain owner and update only from the fresh result.

cmd.doctor.cancel.replacement: owner-specific cancellable command from remediation result; closing Doctor only detaches the viewer
cmd.doctor.cancel.reason: Doctor is a viewer/router; closing detaches the viewer and must not cancel owner ObservableWork. Cancellation remains an exact domain-owner action when that owner exposes it.
cmd.doctor.cancel.intended_semantics: Cancel the exact current Doctor operation only when the semantic owner reports it cancellable.

cmd.doctor.run_all.reason: An unbounded full sweep conflicts with cached-first, relevance-scoped, resource-governed Doctor scheduling. Use ui.doctor.refresh_visible or exact ui.doctor.run_check actions.
cmd.doctor.run_all.intended_semantics: Run every Doctor check as one global sweep.
